pre_transfer_controls: preserve the original failed intake asset, receipt, external events, and partial bytes unchanged
implement and test a separate recovery control that retains the failed attempt as terminal history
revalidate the current normalized CDSE legal section and structured modification date
revalidate exact bytes for the OData documentation, token documentation, and Sentinel Legal Notice
revalidate the exact provider UUID, product name, online state, catalog length, and provider checksums
confirm the destination remains absent and create only a distinct exclusive staging path
obtain a fresh access token only through the existing owner-controlled protected credential reference
transfer_controls: request the complete exact product from byte zero without Range or resume semantics
stream to the distinct exclusive staging path while computing local SHA-256 and provider MD5
require exact catalog length and provider MD5 before promotion
promote with atomic no-replace semantics and rehash the promoted file
run the existing offline ZIP and SAFE container verification without extraction
post_success_release: reconcile M1-SRC-004 as satisfied only through the separately approved successful recovery identity
resume the four still-unattempted products under the original eight-product approval, one at a time
stop and preserve evidence on any later transfer or verification failure
proposed_recovery.failure_policy: Any recovery failure is terminal for that recovery identity and requires another explicit review; no automatic retry is authorized.

approval_would_authorize: implement and validate the exact separate recovery control described here
perform one fresh full M1-SRC-004 transfer from byte zero through a new exclusive staging path
verify and promote only that exact product if every existing identity, rights, length, checksum, path, and container control passes
after a passing recovery, continue only M1-SRC-005, M1-SRC-006, M1-SRC-008, and M1-SRC-010 under the original approval
approval_would_not_authorize: resume, delete, truncate, rename, overwrite, or otherwise modify the retained failed partial or its events
reuse the failed staging path or hide the failed attempt
change the provider UUID, product name, observation time, role, sensor route, destination, or source manifest
accept terms, recover or modify an account, change MFA, incur cost, or expose credentials
acquire substitute imagery, additional products, or precise orbit files
perform radar terrain correction, pixel admission, change mapping, attribution, or scientific publication
limitations: The reason CDSE ended the response early is not established.
A fresh retry may fail again and has no automatic second retry.
Container success would not establish raster readability, AOI coverage, usable pixels, registration, or scientific change.
This proposal creates no authority until the exact review bundle is approved and reconciled.
